resources.string: The certificate has expired. Check your device date and time, and ask the server administrator to renew the certificate.
The certificate is not valid yet. Check your device date and time and the certificate\'s validity period.
The server certificate does not match the domain you entered. Check the self-hosted address and the certificate returned by the reverse proxy.

We could not verify the server certificate. Check the complete server certificate chain, the device\'s trusted CAs, and whether a proxy replaces HTTPS certificates. For a self-signed server, configure its CA in the certificate settings.
We could not establish a secure TLS connection. Check the server or reverse proxy\'s TLS configuration and protocol versions, and the client certificate if mTLS is enabled.
We could not resolve the server domain. Check the self-hosted address, DNS, VPN, and proxy settings.
The connection to the server timed out. Check that the server is online and review the port, network, VPN, and proxy settings.
We could not connect to the server. Check the address and port, confirm that the service is running, and review firewall and proxy settings.
The proxy refused the connection or requires authentication. Check the proxy address, port, and account settings.
The server address uses HTTP, which the current security policy does not allow. Use an HTTPS address and check the reverse proxy\'s HTTPS configuration.
A network error interrupted communication with the server. Check your network, VPN, and proxy settings, then try again.
Some team items could not be decrypted (%1$d). Readable items were synced; existing affected items were retained. Check organization membership and sign in again.
Some items could not be synced (%1$d). Readable items were synced; existing local data was retained.
